description: This file defines a Salesforce CRM service class with methods for managing Salesforce events, contacts, token refresh, and querying Salesforce data. It includes interfaces, error handling, and utility functions specific to Salesforce integration within a larger application.

classes.name: SalesforceCRMService
classes.description: Implements CRM interface for Salesforce, managing tokens, creating/updating/deleting events, and querying contacts/accounts.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes Salesforce OAuth token, updates credential store, and optionally recalibrates token lifetime.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates a Salesforce connection, handling token validation and refresh logic.

methods.name: getSalesforceUserIdFromEmail
methods.description: Retrieves Salesforce User ID based on email.

methods.name: getSalesforceUserFromUserId
methods.description: Retrieves Salesforce user details from user ID.

methods.name: salesforceCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates a Salesforce Event record with provided calendar event data.

methods.name: salesforceUpdateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing Salesforce Event record.

methods.name: salesforceDeleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a Salesforce Event record or writes cancellation info based on options.

methods.name: handleEventCreation
methods.description: Handles creation of Salesforce event and returns structured result.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new Salesforce event, returns CRM event info.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts or accounts from Salesforce based on emails and options.

methods.name: getContactOrLeadFromEmail
methods.description: Searches Salesforce for contact or lead matching email.

methods.name: createContacts
methods.description: Creates contacts or leads in Salesforce based on attendee data and options.
